import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from ref import Topo

def words_for(request):
    import importlib.util
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mp','/workspace/submission/main.py')
    M=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(M)
    return M.transport(request)

BIN='/workspace/tmp/unit-merge-build/engine'

def engine_time(request, label):
    data = words_for(request)
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([BIN], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    el=time.time()-t0
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-26s engine %6.2fs words=%d out=%d rc=%d rss=%.0fMB' % (label, el, len(data), len(p.stdout), p.returncode, ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
    return el

rng=random.Random(5)
# 1) one huge group, 50000 transactions x 2 edits, N=3
spec=['leaf-spine',2,1]; topo=Topo(spec)
d=100000
tasks=[[0,0,1,0,0] for _ in range(d)]
for i in range(1,d,2): tasks[i]=[1,1,1,0,0] if False else tasks[i]
groups=[[1,10**12],[1,10**12]]
tasks=[[0,0,1,0,0] for _ in range(d//2)] + [[1,1,1,0,0] for _ in range(d//2)]
caps=[1,1,0]
txs=[]
for i in range(50000):
    txs.append({'revision':i,'edits':[['move',(2*i)%d,1],['move',(2*i+1)%d,0]],'query':{'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]}})
req={'version':2,'sessions':[{'topology':spec,'caps':caps,'groups':groups,'tasks':tasks,'query':{'groups':[0,1],'nodes':[0,1],'tasks':[]},'transactions':txs}]}
engine_time(req,'huge-group churn')

# 2) many transactions, dense topology (clos 18)
spec=['clos',18,'tor',1]; topo=Topo(spec); n=topo.n
by_dom={}
for tid,dm in enumerate(topo.domains): by_dom.setdefault(dm,[]).append(tid)
doms=sorted(by_dom)
g=64
groups=[[1,10**12]]*g
tasks=[[by_dom[doms[i%len(doms)]][0], i%g, 1, 0, i%3==0] for i in range(2000)]
txs=[{'revision':i,'edits':[['move',rng.randrange(2000),rng.randrange(g)],['quota',rng.randrange(g),rng.randint(1,4)]],'query':{'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]}} for i in range(20000)]
req={'version':2,'sessions':[{'topology':spec,'caps':[4]*n,'groups':groups,'tasks':tasks,'query':{'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]},'transactions':txs}]}
engine_time(req,'clos18 20k tx')

# 3) one transaction with 100000 edits on a dense footprint topology
spec=['torus2d',9,'host']; topo=Topo(spec); n=topo.n
g=512
tasks=[[rng.randrange(len(topo.foots)), i%g, 1, 0, 0] for i in range(100000)]
fp=[set() for _ in range(g)]
for t in tasks: fp[t[1]]|=set(topo.foots[t[0]])
caps=[0]*n
for gid in range(g):
    for x in fp[gid]: caps[x]+=1
edits=[['move',i,g-1-(i%g)] for i in range(100000)]
req={'version':2,'sessions':[{'topology':spec,'caps':caps,'groups':[[1,10**12]]*g,'tasks':tasks,'query':{'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]},'transactions':[{'revision':0,'edits':edits,'query':{'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]}}]}]}
engine_time(req,'100k edits one tx')

# 4) 200000 queried ids
spec=['dragonfly',43,7,6,'target']; topo=Topo(spec); n=topo.n
tasks=[[0,0,1,0,0],[1,0,1,0,0]]
req={'version':2,'sessions':[{'topology':spec,'caps':[1]*n,'groups':[[1,10**12]],'tasks':tasks,'query':{'groups':[0]*70000,'nodes':[0]*70000,'tasks':[0]*60000},'transactions':[]}]}
engine_time(req,'200k query ids')
